messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Kicking off planning for the Independence Day event. Working assumption is we go live 12 August, config frozen by the 5th so QA gets a clean week.

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: sounds good, will start blocking calendar time for it

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Success on this one is ARPDAU lift across the seven-day window. Everything else is secondary.

messages.author: farah.qureshi
messages.text: noted, will keep an eye on the regression pass for this one

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: Event runs seven days from go-live, and Meera owns the config freeze.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: Reward table has 12 tiers in the design doc.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Config only has 8 tiers built.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: oh — let me check with art on that

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: My mistake, doc was stale. 8 tiers is correct, I've updated it.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: no worries, appreciate the quick fix

messages.author: arjun.rao
messages.text: Launch is the 5th for us — that's when the Canada and NZ cohort gets it.

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: Launch is the 15th.

messages.author: arjun.rao
messages.text: ah got it, different cohort then, makes sense

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Calendar sign-off sits with me. That was the whole point of the change we made after Holi.

messages.author: farah.qureshi
messages.text: makes sense to me, keeps things simple on our end too

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: To be clear, we are not going with the 15th. Nothing has changed on my side.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: got it, thanks for the clarity

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Theme is tricolour board skins and a token set, plus a limited-time Tiranga tournament mode shipping with the event.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: love the theme direction, will start sketching concepts

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: Spent this morning on bracket seeding rules for the Tiranga tournament. Should have the seeding logic ready for review by Tuesday.

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: nice, keep us posted on how the review goes

messages.author: arjun.rao
messages.text: D7 is down, not up. My cut on paid installs has seven-day retention off 3pp since the 1.9.3 patch.

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: lunch? 🍛

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: on it 🙋

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: Sharing the release plan for the Independence Day event. Go-live is 15 August, aligned to the holiday itself. Sign-off gate is the 12th.

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: As producer I'll hold final sign-off on the live ops calendar, same as we did for Holi.

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: farah.qureshi
messages.text: Thanks for the summary, Priya. Will circulate to the QA team and flag anything that needs earlier visibility.

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: Art is fully committed to the Independence assets through the 5th, so we're covered on the visual side.

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: Acknowledged. Will keep the backend team's calendar aligned with this thread going forward.

messages.subject: Ludo Junction — Independence Day event release sign-off
messages.author: karthik.nair
messages.text: Let's go with the 15th. Aligning to the holiday itself is worth more than the extra three days of runway. Final.

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: Level 40 art pack, first pass lands 24 July.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: great, will plan the design review around that

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: Revising that — Level 40 pack will be 29 July. Token rework took longer than I scoped.

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: Priya said it's the 15th now, so I've replanned the asset drops around that.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: makes sense, thanks for flagging

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: Heads up, I'm moving two artists onto the Onam board set from tomorrow so we hit that milestone.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: ok, let me know if you need anything from design side

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: Tricolour token set is at final polish.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: looks great in the previews, nice work

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: Leaderboard migration for tournament mode depends on the new shard rollout. That's three weeks minimum, so the earliest date I'd call safe is 25 August.

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: will draft a short doc laying out the shard dependencies

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: Push notification service upgrade lands 30 July.

messages.author: farah.qureshi
messages.text: Regression suite now covers the reconnect path.

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: great, that closes a gap we'd been carrying for a while

messages.author: farah.qureshi
messages.text: Build 1.9.4 has an open P1 — token animation desyncs on reconnect. This is not release-ready.

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: taking a look now, will report back shortly

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: We're shipping 1.9.4 on Friday. It's already in the store review queue.

messages.author: vikram.shetty
messages.text: reproduced it locally, digging into the reconnect handler now

messages.subject: Weekly product metrics — w/c 13 July
messages.author: neha.bhatt
messages.text: D7 retention is up 1.8pp week on week, driven mostly by the returning-player cohort.

messages.subject: Weekly product metrics — w/c 13 July
messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Thanks for pulling this together, Neha. Useful context heading into next week.

messages.subject: Weekly product metrics — w/c 13 July
messages.author: neha.bhatt
messages.text: Event dashboard will be ready by the 8th.

messages.subject: Weekly product metrics — w/c 13 July
messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: Great, looking forward to it.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: I want to push back on how we're framing success here. We got hammered on Holi for pushing offers. Success for this event should be session depth and returning players, not ARPDAU.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: hear you, let's talk it through properly rather than over slack

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: On tournament mode, we cut the bracket system for v1. It's a flat leaderboard only.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: ok, noted — will fold that into the design doc

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: appreciate you raising the concern earlier, want to get this right

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: Difficulty curve for levels 38–42 is rebalanced.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: nice, curious to see how playtesting responds

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: What if we pushed the tournament to September and shipped just the skins in August?

messages.author: priya.raghunathan
messages.text: Onam event target go-live is 26 August. Putting it on the calendar now.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: great, thanks for getting that on the calendar

messages.author: sana.kulkarni
messages.text: will start scoping the board set on our end

messages.author: deepak.menon
messages.text: Steady trickle of reports that players are still seeing the old Holi reward table in the shop.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: The reward config was updated on the 18th. It's live.

messages.author: deepak.menon
messages.text: FAQ update for the event is drafted.

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: thanks, will take a look this afternoon

messages.author: deepak.menon
messages.text: quiet week on the ticket front, nothing else to flag

messages.text: looking into the seeding branch failure now

messages.author: arjun.rao
messages.text: Is the go-live date still the 12th?

messages.author: meera.iyer
messages.text: checking on that, will confirm shortly

messages.author: arjun.rao
messages.text: Creative refresh for the August burst is booked with the agency.

messages.author: rohan.desai
messages.text: morning, anything blocking from your side before the sync?
